name: @velqu/browser-pglite
description: Velqu optional browser-local SQL capability (BWASM-C-003): the frozen async Postgres operation subset mapped onto PGlite running in the browser. Browser-local prototype data only — never multi-user, production-durable, or native-Postgres-performance. The native `postgres` grant stays deployment-required; this adapter is a distinct, opt-in surface.
